_comment: This repo self-hosts its own marketplace: the real, deployed entry is /.claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the repo root (source: "./plugin", the simplest form for a plugin living in a subdirectory of the same repo as its marketplace). This file is a reference example for a DIFFERENT scenario -- forking this plugin's source into its own repo and listing it from a separate marketplace -- where the git-subdir source form is required because there is no shared repo root to resolve a relative path against.
name: claude-code-design
description: Design-grade HTML artifacts (decks, prototypes, wireframes, animated video, design systems) built through skills, commands and a hardened Bash/browser guard.
